Commentary: Nayeem Hasan to Amir Jangoo, no run, full outside off, driven to extra cover
Another visit from the Bangladesh physio! He's been busy in this session and it's the keeper who wants his attention again. No urgency from the players to get on with it.
Nayeem Hasan to Amir Jangoo, 2 runs, drifting in on leg, Jangoo hangs back and tucks it behind square for a couple of runs
Nayeem Hasan to Amir Jangoo, no run, good length on off, defended off the back foot

Nayeem Hasan to Amir Jangoo, 2 runs, floated up on a length outside off, Jangoo waits on the back foot before chopping it behind backward point. It's a chase for Taskin who runs after it laboriously and manages to cut it off

Mehidy Hasan Miraz to Kavem Hodge, no run, now a blow to the leg for Litton Das and there comes the physio once more! Lost count how many visits he's had to the middle in this session. Down the leg-side, he looks to sweep and drags it off the under-edge onto Das's left foot

The spray being used to numb the pain. Das gets up with a limp and is now inspecting his foot. West Indies coach Sammy is making some gestures from the balcony aimed at the Bangladesh players. All in good fun. Meanwhile, the entire pitch is now under shadows
Mehidy Hasan Miraz to Kavem Hodge, no run, overpitched on off, driven back to Mehidy
Mehidy Hasan Miraz to Kavem Hodge, 1 run, punched off the back foot to long-on
Mehidy Hasan Miraz to Amir Jangoo, no run, 86kph, good length ball close to off, Jangoo hangs back and punches to backward point
Mehidy Hasan Miraz to Amir Jangoo, no run, overpitched on off, driven to short cover
Mehidy Hasan Miraz to Amir Jangoo, no run, 91kph, full at the stumps, Jangoo smothers it on the front foot

Nayeem Hasan to Kavem Hodge, no run, sharp turn off a length! From round the wicket, it's pitches just outside off and rips back at the stumps, hitting Hodge high on the bat as he hangs back to defend
Nayeem Hasan to Kavem Hodge, 2 runs, goes for the sweep and it flies off the top-edge past the keeper
Nayeem Hasan to Kavem Hodge, no run, drifting across off, goes on with the arm and Hodge tucks it to midwicket off the back foot
Nayeem Hasan to Kavem Hodge, no run, looks to sweep but is hit on the arm. Keeper is the only one appealing. Impact was well outside off and it was going on with the angle from round the wicket
Nayeem Hasan to Kavem Hodge, no run, dances down, doesn't get to the pitch and is forced to defend
Nayeem Hasan to Kavem Hodge, 1 run, dragged down short, pulled hard to deep backward square

We'll have to wait and see how West Indies approach things tomorrow. They'd probably want to take any chance of a Bangladesh win out of the equation before declaring on a pitch that is still holding up quite well. There's more turn on offer but it's slow turn, allowing batters enough time to adjust. A draw seems the likely result at this stage but who knows. Can never predict how a fourth innings on a final day can go. That's it for now. Goodbye!
